parent_whitelist_policy: v1 remains immutable; v2 adds history-derived phase_state only; sample IDs, target, qualification, horizon, partitions and primary metric unchanged
mode_observation_known: four flags finite/binary, exactly one active, interpolated=0; other combinations retained as mode_unknown
historical_information: only mode flags/quality from the same frozen partition up to and including origin t; no pre-partition modes or future rows
observed_run: current uninterrupted known Mode_PQ=1 sequence; any unknown observation ends the provable prefix, not necessarily actual device operation
exact_age: known only when observed PQ run is immediately preceded by a known non-PQ row in the same partition; exact_pq_age_s otherwise null, never zero-filled
lower_bound: zero-based elapsed logged seconds from beginning of current observed PQ sequence; null for non-PQ or unknown mode
left_censoring: PQ run begins at partition start or after unknown mode/quality; exact age remains unknown throughout the run, lower bound retained

phase_rules.mode_unknown: current flags/quality cannot establish a single mode
phase_rules.pq_sustained_observed: at least three consecutive known PQ rows observed (lower bound>=2), even if exact start remains left-censored
phase_rules.pq_start_unknown: current PQ known, exact age unknown and fewer than three consecutive known PQ rows observed

prefix_provenance: phase_history_start_native_row through t contains needed modes; known start includes preceding non-PQ row; unknown start includes available ambiguity/boundary evidence; never crosses partition
availability_assumption: same log-row joint-availability assumption as v1, expanded to the stated historical prefix; actual delivery/sample-update timestamps unknown
output: phase_features.csv.gz sidecar keyed to every immutable v1 sample; no target/future values in the feature file
keep: every v1 sample including non-PQ, unknown modes, left-censored phases, future changes and large errors; no target-based exclusion
existing_data_use: phase categories inspired by already-seen evaluation residuals; all April partitions stage-inspected; exploratory retrospective comparisons only
change_policy: new prefix/whitelist version is explicit; no overwrite of v1 source, samples, labels, baseline parameters or results
